","t":"Inter ép sân, Milan giữ lợi thế"}]}--> AC Milan 3 - 1 Inter Second half — 79th minute 79' The match is in progress. Current score: AC Milan 3 - 1 Inter.
 75' VAR cancels Inter's penalty. In the 75th minute, Inter's penalty decision involving Henrikh Mkhitaryan was overturned after a VAR review. Inter missed the opportunity to narrow the gap while trailing AC Milan 3-1.
 73' Inter pressed hard, Milan maintained their advantage. In the 73rd minute, AC Milan led Inter 3-1 despite facing intense pressure. Inter had 53% possession and a superior number of shots on goal (14-6), while Milan had to defend to protect their lead.
 72' Inter brought Zieliński onto the field. In the 72nd minute, Inter brought Piotr Zieliński on to replace Hakan Çalhanoğlu. The visitors needed more attacking impetus as they were trailing AC Milan 1-3.
 72' Inter brought Mkhitaryan onto the field. In the 72nd minute, Inter brought Henrikh Mkhitaryan on to replace Andy Diouf. The visitors were trailing AC Milan 1-3 despite having had more shots on goal.
 61' Inter had many shots on goal, giving Milan a comfortable lead. In the 61st minute, AC Milan led Inter 3-1 despite facing considerable pressure. Inter had a clear advantage in shots on goal (11-5) and corners (7-1), but Milan still maintained their two-goal lead.
 52' Diego Moreira received a yellow card for time-wasting. In the 52nd minute, AC Milan's Diego Moreira received a yellow card for time-wasting. This was AC Milan's second yellow card after the break, with the team leading Inter 3-1.
 49' Inter dominated but Milan took the lead. In the 49th minute, Inter controlled possession and led 9-5 in shots on goal, but AC Milan still held a 3-1 lead. The Nerazzurri also dominated 7-1 in corner kicks, while Milan were under pressure in their own half.
 49' Koni De Winter received a yellow card. In the 49th minute, Koni De Winter of AC Milan received a yellow card for a foul. AC Milan were still leading Inter 3-1.
 46' The second half has begun. The second half has begun.
 45' End of the first half At the end of the first half, the score was 3-1.
 43' Diego Moreira extended AC Milan's lead. In the 43rd minute, Diego Moreira scored, giving AC Milan a 3-1 lead over Inter. The home team restored their two-goal advantage after Inter pulled one back.
 36' Inter pressed hard, but Milan still took the lead. In the 36th minute, AC Milan led Inter 2-1 despite being under considerable pressure. Inter had a slight advantage in possession with 52% compared to 48%, and also dominated with 8-3 shots and 7-1 corners.
 24' Milan took the lead, but Inter continued to take shots on goal. In the 24th minute, AC Milan led Inter 2-1 and had more possession with 58% compared to 42%. However, Inter still showed their attacking prowess, having a 5-3 advantage in shots on goal.
 22' Bastoni rekindles hope for Inter. In the 22nd minute, Alessandro Bastoni scored for Inter after an assist from Manuel Akanji. Inter narrowed the gap, with the score now AC Milan 2-1 Inter.
 12' AC Milan dominated Inter. By the 12th minute, AC Milan led Inter 2-0 and had a slight advantage in possession, with 56% compared to 44%. The leading team had two shots, both on target, while Inter had yet to register a single shot.
 10' Rabiot doubled AC Milan's lead. In the 10th minute, Adrien Rabiot scored from an assist by Diego Moreira, giving AC Milan a 2-0 lead over Inter. The home team had a very effective start with two goals in just 10 minutes.
 4' Pulisic opened the scoring for AC Milan. In the 4th minute, Christian Pulisic scored from an assist by Diego Moreira, giving AC Milan a 1-0 lead over Inter. The early goal gave AC Milan an advantage over the league leaders.
 0' The match has started. AC Milan hosts Inter.

The home team also has reason to be confident: they have won all three of their most recent encounters without conceding a single victory. The match takes place at 02:45 on November 1st, 2026 at the San Siro/Giuseppe Meazza stadium.
 Inter carried their winning streak and the top spot in the table.
 Inter have won four of their last five matches, with their only defeat coming at the furthest point in that run. All four of those recent games have ended with three points, demonstrating their consistency and ability to maintain a consistent pace across multiple matches.
 That achievement is clearly reflected in the standings. Inter are currently in first place with 25 points, a position they want to consolidate further when facing a city rival.
 AC Milan lacks consistency.
 AC Milan's form has been inconsistent. They have won 3 and lost 2 of their last 5 matches, including a defeat in their most recent game. This alternating pattern of wins and losses suggests the team has yet to find a consistent rhythm.
 AC Milan are currently in fifth place with 18 points, seven points behind league leaders Inter. With this gap, the home team needs a positive result to close the gap and regain momentum after their recent defeat.
 The odds are tilted in favor of the home team.
 In their last five meetings, AC Milan have won three, drawn two, and Inter have yet to win. This is a psychological advantage for the home team, especially as they are facing a team that is in better form at the moment.
 However, history doesn't guarantee the outcome. Inter enter the match with a winning streak and top spot in the league, so the unlucky encounter may no longer hold much significance.
 The key point of the match
 The first factor is psychology. Inter are motivated to extend their winning streak, while AC Milan need to react immediately after their last defeat and capitalize on their home advantage. The match could therefore start at a high tempo, with both teams wanting to control the game early on.
 The second factor is consistency. Inter have demonstrated the ability to achieve consistent results, while AC Milan frequently alternate between wins and losses. Whichever team maintains focus for longer than 90 minutes will have a greater advantage.
 Assessment
 Considering their current form and league position, Inter are considered slightly superior. However, their head-to-head record and home advantage give AC Milan a solid basis to compete on equal terms. If Inter win again, the gap with AC Milan will widen. Conversely, a positive result for the home team would make the race even more exciting.
